description: Capture a public HTTP(S) page as PNG, PDF or rendered HTML. Records what the PageVerified renderer saw; not a forensic chain of custody. PNG and HTML cost 1 credit; PDF costs 2 credits. Captures run in a shared browser pool, with a limit on the browser time used in one day and in any 31 days. If the pool is used up, a capture call answers 503 capture_capacity_reached and costs nothing until capacity returns. One key cannot use the whole pool: a key that has used its share, or has had too many failed captures today, gets 429 capture_share_reached, also at no cost. Other tools are not affected.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS page to render
